QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] More Data
QuestInfo.0: Eremos can tell you where the next training location is.
QuestInfo.1: Minar Forest is under the rule of the evil dragon Horntail. Eremos say you can use your newfound power to free Minar Forest from Horntail's rule. Hopefully you're not biting off more than you can chew.
QuestInfo.2: Head to Minar Forest to gather information about how to defeat Horntail.
